finalproject

Yitian(Ethan) Chen · BST260 · Fall 2026

For my final project, I plan to study BMI and systolic blood pressure in NHANES and compare foodborne and waterborne outbreak sizes in CDC data. The proposal describes the questions, datasets, and analyses I plan to use.

  • Proposal
  • Project website

Install

With R 4.5.0 or later:

devtools::install_github("EthanCHEN6/finalproject")
data("waterborne", package = "finalproject")

Build the website

Install Quarto and the R packages pkgdown, quarto, knitr, and rmarkdown. Open finalproject.Rproj and run:

pkgdown::build_site()

GitHub Pages publishes the docs/ folder on main.

Course template

This repository is forked from Vincent Carey’s BST260 template. It retains the course datasets, instructions, and project suggestions. My proposal is in vignettes/proposal.qmd.
